title: Art. 9.13 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 9 - Passenger Data Exchange Systems, B. Advance Passenger Information (API), 9.13
content: If a Contracting State requires API data interchange, then it shall seek, to the greatest extent possible, to limit the operational and administrative burdens on aircraft operators, while enhancing passenger facilitation.
